_comment: Keys are 'L<layer>C<clip>' matching Resolume's OSC clip-connect address (/composition/layers/<layer>/clips/<clip>/connect). Trigger any of these clips in Resolume and the bridge generates that look. '_default' is used when a triggered clip has no mapping.
_default: abstract generative art, colorful, high detail
L1C1: neon jellyfish, cyberpunk city, glowing, night, high detail
L1C2: molten lava landscape, cracked obsidian, abstract, dramatic lighting
